description: R1-frontier cost calibration: GPT-5.6 Terra over the 5-maze R1 smoke manifest (30/42/47/61/80 optimal steps, out-of-panel) with the R1 fixed cell and the SAME model params as run_config.r1_frontier.json (xhigh, 64k, image_detail=high) except the model, the tier and the spend cap. Measures OpenAI-family queries/episode and per-query reasoning/output tokens to project the Astra panel cost via scripts/estimate_frontier_cost.py. NOT a scored panel.
_note_no_conditions: No conditions key => single (default) cell built from experiment_config overlay.
_note_model_params: Standard tier (no service_tier) for predictable latency; the estimator re-prices at flex. spend_cap_usd=40 hard-stops the process (worst case if every query hit the 64k cap would be ~$0.77/query).
